question: Does the current consolidation labelled 2025-08-13 contain wording introduced only by a corrigendum published in 2026?

observations.locator: Article 1(4)(b) replacing Regulation 794/2004 Article 4(1), second sentence
observations.observed_text: However an increase in the original budget of an existing aid that is authorised or deemed compatible under Regulation (EU) No 651/2014 by up to 20 % shall not be considered an alteration to existing aid.

observations.replaces_text: However an increase in the original budget of an existing aid that is authorised or deemed compatible under Regulation (EU) No 651/2014 by up to 20 % shall not be considered an alteration to existing aid.
observations.corrected_text: However an increase in the original budget of an existing aid scheme that is authorised or deemed compatible under Regulation (EU) No 651/2014 by up to 20 % shall not be considered an alteration to existing aid.

observations.observed_text: However an increase in the original budget of an existing aid scheme that is authorised or deemed compatible under Regulation (EU) No 651/2014 by up to 20 % shall not be considered an alteration to existing aid.

temporal_result.EX_POST_LEGAL_EFFECT: Current official consolidation may show the corrected wording when reconstructing the corrected historical text state.

finding: Independent real-world confirmation of the frozen P0-F consolidation-backprojection invariant. A current EUR-Lex consolidation labelled 2025-08-13 can contain wording sourced from a corrigendum published on 2026-07-17.
forbidden_inferences: The 2025-08-13 consolidation label proves that the corrected wording was publicly visible on 2025-08-13.
The current consolidated representation is a source-state-as-of archive for its label date.
Every correction is back-projected into every consolidation or language expression.
source_notes: The original 2025/905 publication is the authentic before source for the corrected phrase.
The 2026 corrigendum explicitly supplies both the for/read replacement wording.
The current 2025-08-13 consolidation is observed ex post and is not evidence of contemporaneous source availability.
